annotation.summary: A sweating person struggles to choose between two buttons.
annotation.visual: The upper panel contains two red buttons and a hovering hand. Below, a person wipes sweat from their forehead.
annotation.mechanism: Two appealing but incompatible demands, or two conflicting beliefs, turn a small decision into an exaggerated crisis.
scenarios: Want to leave work on time and also finish one more feature
Choose between saving money and buying a new gadget
Publicly support two beliefs that contradict each other

examples.why: The person wants both outcomes, which compete for the same time.

avoid: The struggle should come from a recognizable conflict between the two choices.
annotation.basis: Creative interpretation based on inspected source media; not a verified account of historical origin.
